issue.title: 🚀 Feature: Settlement CSV export
issue.body:
## Bounded Context
Settlement domain. Merchant actor. Reads from `settlements` table; no write side effects.

## User Stories

### Story 1: Export settlements as CSV

- As a **Merchant**, I want **to export my settlement list as a CSV file** so that **I can use it in my accounting software**

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Merchants can click "Export CSV" to download all settlements matching the current filter
- [ ] The CSV includes columns: date, reference, description, amount, status
- [ ] Amounts are formatted as decimal numbers (e.g. 1234.56)
- [ ] The export filename includes the date range (e.g. `settlements-2026-01-01-2026-03-31.csv`)
- [ ] Exports of more than 10,000 rows are chunked and delivered as a ZIP archive

#### Scenarios

```gherkin
Scenario: Merchant exports the filtered settlement list
  Given a Merchant applied a filter to the settlement list
  When the Merchant clicks "Export CSV"
  Then a CSV downloads with the columns date, reference, description, amount, status
  And amounts are formatted as decimal numbers

Scenario: Large export is delivered as a ZIP archive
  Given the current filter matches more than 10,000 settlements
  When the Merchant clicks "Export CSV"
  Then the export is chunked
  And it is delivered as a ZIP archive

Scenario: Empty result set exports headers only
  Given the current filter matches no settlements
  When the Merchant clicks "Export CSV"
  Then a CSV downloads with headers only
  And no error is shown
```

## Edge Cases

- Empty result set (no settlements in range) → export a CSV with headers only, no error
- Export triggered while filter is loading → button is disabled until filter resolves
- Network failure during download → browser shows native download error; no partial file is saved

## Domain Events

- Emits: `SettlementExportRequested` — emitted when a Merchant triggers a CSV export
- Emits: `SettlementExportReady` — emitted when the file is available for download
- Consumes: —

## Trace Plan

1. [ ] ☄️ Skeleton — Export settlements as CSV: proves the export path from button to downloaded file (claims: "Merchant exports the filtered settlement list")
2. [ ] ☄️ Deepening — export edge handling (claims: "Large export is delivered as a ZIP archive", "Empty result set exports headers only")
